text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono has pulled to the front in
the last
hundred meters! She's putting all
180 centimeters
of her height to good
use in those powerful
strides!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Rrrraaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The rest of the pack is trying to catch
up, but
they just can't reach her! And it's
Hishi Akebono,
blasting past the finish
line at top speed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono and I have started our
sprint
toward the Twinkle Series. After
an exciting
scrimmage wraps up...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The soup's refreshing taste comes from
the
seasonings. I went with kombu
seaweed and light
soy sauce, as well as
sake, mirin, and salt! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And the meatballs should be infused
with those
yummy flavors too! I used
miso and salt as secret
ingredients, so
they're on the sweeter side.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I also kneaded the meatballs while
adding water
to the paste to really bring
out the umami flavors!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Aaand there! Hishi Akebono's Special
Chanko is
done! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, everyone! You have to eat up so
you'll all
be ready to take on tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono is in the middle of
serving chanko
to an army of students.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right? I made a heap of food so
everyone can
have their fill after running
so hard during the
scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But the food's nearly gone already! I'm
glad
everyone ate so much, though!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I'd better hurry and eat too! Hold
on, I'll go
grab some for you as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's dream is to become like
chanko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a runner who opponents can
race
against with all their strength!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Someone who can feel proud of her
efforts, and
who always ends up with a
smile on her face,
whether she wins or
loses!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that's why I entered Tracen
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants both herself and her
opponents to be
able to run with all
they've got, without any
regrets. And
she wants to cook up enough food
to fill
everybody up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's the sort of person she wants to
be.
Someone who's vital to ensuring that
all sumo
wrestlers can be sturdy and
powerful together...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Essentially, she wants to be their chanko.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you kindly, Akebono! Boy howdy,
was it
fun to hang out with y'all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're quite incredible, but I will be the
victor
next time we race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
After all, I do feel incredibly energized
after
eating so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle, a student with a tall figure
and an
even bigger heart, and Sakura
Bakushin O, a
rather intense class
representative, have come to
say a
happy hello.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O specializes in sprints,
while
Taiki Shuttle's fortes are sprints
and miles. Both
are spectacular racers in
their own right.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Me too! Here's to a great race
next
time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew! That was fun.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Actually, I was just thinking
about how
much I love seeing everyone
smile, just like they
did today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And about how I want to keep doing
everything I
can in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It'd be nice to run really good races with

everyone, and then all smile together...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to work really hard to make that
all
happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tap, tap, tap, tap!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono, Bono, Bono, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus, a hero-idolizing student
who's
good friends with Hishi Akebono,
comes running
up to us.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh my. What is it, Biko?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Come quick! You have to see what's on
TV!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pushing us from behind, Biko Pegasus
hurries us
to my office...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono is one of the tallest
racers to run
in the Twinkle Series since
its founding!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She's scheduled to make her debut this
year, and
her stature has already
garnered a lot of
attention from fans!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Look, Bono, you're on TV! Isn't that
amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! We recorded this stuff the other
day. Ahaha!
They made me look really
cool!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
She's so big and cute! I fell for her the
moment I
saw her in that magazine!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
I just can't wait until Hishi Akebono runs
her
debut race!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono hasn't even debuted yet,
and she's
already a hot topic. We have
nothing but great
expectations for her
future!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wow. Everyone's already so excited to
see me.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
How are you so calm?! You're on
everyone's radar
and you haven't even
debuted yet!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yeah, you have a point there. I
guess it
does feel a little weird!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me... People have been
commenting
and wishing me good luck
with my debut on
Umastagram lately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's a social media platform where
you can
post pictures or do live streams!
I stream while I
cook sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Um, let's see... Here! Look at these
comments!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are lots of messages expressing
excitement
for Hishi Akebono's debut,
and wishing her luck,
but a few messages
in particular catch my
attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One says, "No way is she gonna be able
to run
long distances with such a huge
body," while
another reads: "She's so
powerful... Wouldn't she
be better on
dirt?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice another one. "She must weigh a
lot too,
and that's gotta put a ton of
strain on her legs. I
wonder if she'll be
okay..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: They sure do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I'm not very confident
about my
stamina since I'm so big, and
that my legs have to
take more strain
than lighter racers'...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But I still don't think being big is a bad
thing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I always have a clear view of what's
around me, I
can reach whatever I need,
and placing first is
really fun!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! If you weren't big, you wouldn't
be Bono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You're so right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, the best approach
would be to
utilize her size to the fullest
as we train hard and
seize those wins in
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a few days since I came up with
my plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono and I chat about her
future over a
pot of chanko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want me to focus on bulking
up for a
while?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm, okay...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A larger body mass can help with
reaching top
speed quickly, among lots
of other things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Hishi Akebono could
wield her
exceptional size as a weapon
that's unique to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, in order to make the best use of
that
weapon...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We will?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I draw a comparison between a
motorcycle and a
bus. If the two vehicles
turned the same corner at
the same
speed, the bigger, heavier bus would be

subjected to a more intense centrifugal
force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more mass you have, the more
centrifugal
force will be exerted on you,
and that results in a
greater burden
being placed on your body as it
tries to
manage that force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, it takes a considerable
amount of
leg strength for a heavy racer
to go from standing
still to top speed,
which creates even more strain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I break down my reasoning into smaller,
easily
understood concepts, and she
listens to me with
ever-widening eyes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So you really think I should bulk up
rather than
slim down?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Oh... Okay, I'll do my best to
bulk up,
then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was thinking that way would
be truer
to myself, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad we're on the same page,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to focus more on training than
having
Hishi Akebono run in races, at
least until we've
finished building up her
body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we really want to capitalize on her
strengths,
then we have to take our time
and be thorough
with our preparation.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Would you like some seconds?
You can
have as much as you like!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a great big smile on her face, Hishi
Akebono
scoops more sweet chicken
meatballs into my
bowl.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Akebono and I set off
together on
our journey toward the
Twinkle Series!
